clos.original_description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental principles in image and video processing, digital signal processing in time domain and frequency domain
clos.enriched_description: Gain a comprehensive understanding of fundamental image and video processing and digital signal processing principles, including gray-level and binary image processing, enhancement, linear and nonlinear filtering, morphological filtering, frequency-domain filtering, noise reduction, image recovery, image/video analysis, wavelet transforms, and image noise models.

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in applying the tradditional and machine learning-based techniques for image and video acquisition, digitization, enhancement, restoration.
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in applying the tradditional and machine learning-based techniques for image and video acquisition, digitization, enhancement, restoration, including Basic Gray-Level Image Processing, Basic binary image processing, Image and Video Processing (Enhancement), Basic Linear Filtering with Application to Image Enhancement, Nonlinear Filtering for Image Analysis and Enhancement, Morphological Filtering for Image Enhancement and Feature Detection.

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods to compress images and video
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods to compress images and video, including Image compression, Wavelet Image Compression, Lossy Image Compression: JPEG, JPEG2000 Standards, Recovery Methods for Postprocessing of Compressed Images, Image compression based on machine learning/deep learning, Video compression, Basic Concepts, Techniques of Video Coding and the H.Standard, Interframe Subband/Wavelet Scalable Video Coding, Digital Video Transcoding, MPEG, MPEG-Video Standards.

clos.original_description: Acquire practical skills by using and implementing traditional and machine learning based tools to segment and extract features of an image
clos.enriched_description: Acquire practical skills by using and implementing traditional and machine learning based tools to segment and extract features of an image, including Image, Video segmentation, Clustering and superpixels based segmentation, Segmentation using graph cuts, The use of motion in segmentation, Statistical Methods for Image Segmentation, Video Segmentation, Neural Methods for Image Segmentation, Machine learning/deep learning based segmentation.

clos.original_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods in object detection, motion estimation and video analysis.
clos.enriched_description: Develop expertise in applying traditional and machine learning based methods in object detection, motion estimation and video analysis, including Machine learning based features, Object detection, Neural network, Deep learning based classifiers, Deep convoluntional neural network based classifiers.
